QuestInfo.name: A Gift of Boogies
QuestInfo.0: 10 Boogies wants to give a gift to Dances with Balrog. Thing is, she's too shy, so she needs someone to deliver it for her.
QuestInfo.1: Deliver a gift to Dances with Balrog on behalf of the bashful secret agent, 10 Boogies.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered a gift to Dances with Balrog.

0.0: Dances with Balrog always helps me, so I wanna do something nice for him. I got him this gift, but...I'm too shy to give it to him. Could you take it for me, please?

yes.0: Hooray! Thank you so much! I hope Dances with Balrog likes it a lot.

no.0: Really? It's just a quick drop-off. I'd do it myself...I'm just so awkward around him...

1.0: Welcome back. Were those Seedlings useful to 10 Boogies?

yes.0: Eh? A gift from 10 Boogies? How nice. I never expected such a thing from her.

npc.0: Give him my present! You're not thinking of stealing it, are you?

lost.0: Why did you lose my gift? Are you trying to make me cry? Thank goodness I found it...please, just take it to Dances with Balrog now, before you lose it again.
